_about: Food-court weekly meal (SPEC 12). One meal per character per week, from any stall. A chain serves dishes[week % dishes.length]. Effects last until the week advances. Effect types: tempHp {formula}, saveBonus {ability, bonus}, skillBonus {skill, bonus}, initiative {bonus}, speed {feet}, resist {damage}, inspiration {}, text {} (the GM adjudicates). Every dish has `text`, the player-facing rule in plain words.

Whet.blurb: Seafolk cooking. Everything was swimming this morning.

dishes.name: Kelp-Wrapped Strait Eel
dishes.text: Until your next match: you can hold your breath twice as long, and you gain 1d4 + 2 temporary hit points when you eat.

dishes.name: Brinefire Chowder Cup
dishes.text: Until your next match: resistance to cold damage.

dishes.name: Salted Lantern-Fish Skewer
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1 to Wisdom (Perception) checks. You can see the glint of things.

Oh Banañons!.blurb: Bananas, done every way a banana can be done.

dishes.name: The Banañon Split
dishes.text: Until your next match: you gain 2d4 temporary hit points when you eat. Sugar rush!

dishes.name: Plantain Power Fritters
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1 to initiative.

dishes.name: Banañon Bread, Warm
dishes.text: Until your next match: once, when you fail a Constitution saving throw, you can reroll it (tell the GM).

Carna.blurb: Meat. Lots of it. Ask about the mystery skewer at your own risk.

dishes.name: Double-Stack Gristle Melt
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1 to Strength (Athletics) checks.

dishes.name: Slow-Roast Owlbear Ribs (probably)
dishes.text: Until your next match: you gain 1d6 + 2 temporary hit points when you eat.

dishes.name: The Mystery Skewer
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1d4 to Constitution saving throws. You've survived worse.

Clara's Brews.blurb: Ales, ciders, and something blue that glows. Adults only.

dishes.name: Clara's Liquid Courage
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1d4 to saving throws against being frightened (tell the GM).

dishes.name: Hot Spiced Cider
dishes.text: Until your next match: resistance to fire damage. It burns going down, so nothing else can.

dishes.name: The Glowing Blue One
dishes.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration. Nobody knows what's in it.

Goo to Go.blurb: Slurpy, wobbly, wildly coloured. Comes with a very wide straw.

dishes.name: Electric Lime Slurp
dishes.text: Until your next match: your walking speed increases by 5 feet.

dishes.name: Wobblegoo Parfait
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1 to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

dishes.name: Brain-Freeze Blaster
dishes.text: Until your next match: resistance to psychic damage. Your head is too cold to think with.

Panto's Try.blurb: Panto street food: sweet, buttery, served with a little bow.

dishes.name: Curtain-Call Croissant
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1 to Charisma (Performance) checks. The crowd loves you.

dishes.name: Encore Éclair
dishes.text: Until your next match: once, after you roll a d20, you can add 1d4 to it (tell the GM).

dishes.name: Masquerade Macarons
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1 to Charisma (Deception) checks.

Grab Grass.blurb: Salads, sprouts, and fresh juice. It's good for you. It knows.

dishes.name: The Whole Garden Bowl
dishes.text: Until your next match: resistance to poison damage.

dishes.name: Green Machine Juice
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1d4 to Wisdom saving throws. You feel extremely centred.

dishes.name: Crunchy Sprout Wrap
dishes.text: Until your next match: once, regain 1d8 extra hit points when you spend Hit Dice on a short rest (tell the GM).

Furious Freja.blurb: Fiefdom cooking, served angry. The spice levels have names, not numbers.

dishes.name: Freja's Furious Noodles
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1 to damage rolls with melee weapon attacks once per turn (tell the GM).

dishes.name: Ember Dumplings
dishes.text: Until your next match: resistance to fire damage.

dishes.name: Wrath Platter for One
dishes.text: Until your next match: +1d4 to Strength saving throws.
